fit.gap_handling_summary: Must-haves are met and shown. The CV does not claim the forklift licence, self-service packaging or 95% stocking, which is honest. It also does not mention the hand pallet jack experience or the paid forklift course willingness that would help on the pallet-delivery point.

evaluation.summary: The CV and letter are truthful and well grounded: nearly every claim traces to the candidate material. The main problems are one stretched claim (the checklist still in use at the stall), a nearly empty second CV page, and a fit that is honest but thin on self-service packaging, 95% stocking, pallet handling and forklift. The letter is clean and consistent with the CV but generic about FreshCart. Useful facts are left out, including the willingness to take a paid forklift course, the pallet jack experience and the Wednesday early-shift need.
